extraction.scope: Every committed src/**/*.lean file; explicit header imports only
extraction.sourceLineMeaning: 1-based line containing the imported module name
extraction.moduleIdMeaning: Index in the lexicographically sorted module-name array (decompress namesFile first)
extraction.sourcePathRule: src/ + module name with dots replaced by slashes + .lean
extraction.comments: Line comments and arbitrarily nested block comments are ignored
extraction.externalImports: Recognized namespace, not expanded or compiled in this index
extraction.aggregateHashRule: SHA-256 over (source relative path + NUL + file SHA-256 hex + LF), in module ID order
